subject: Service impact: regional reachability disruption — customer actions and confirmation
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Brightside Health <ops@brightside.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Service impact: regional reachability disruption — customer actions and confirmation

Hi Quentin / Brightside team,

We observed an intermittent peering degradation affecting requests routed to eu-west-1 and ap-northeast-1 this morning (root cause: a control-plane policy mispropagation at a third-party peering fabric). Some tenant traffic was temporarily dropped or experienced elevated connection resets between 07:40–09:05 UTC.

Immediate guidance we can offer today to reduce error surface while we apply a fabric fix:
- Opt into the "regional affinity override" (console or API) — routes your account to alternate regional egress (us-east-1) for new connections. This preserves session stickiness for most workloads.
- Apply the prefer-region header for server-to-server calls where feasible (prefer-region: us-east-1).
- If you cannot change client headers immediately, enable our sidecar fallback (small config flip; see attached step-by-step).

We are coordinating with CloudPortal NOC and expect a full fabric patch rollout by ~12:30 UTC. If you opt in to the override, we will keep it in place until 24 hours after the fabric patch is validated.

Please reply with the best contact and whether you want us to perform the opt-in for you (we can execute via our support plane once we have written authorization).

Attachments: 20261130-affinity-override-steps.pdf (step-by-step), customer-opt-in-template.csv (to authorize action)

— Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0198

From: Quentin Marsh <quentin@brightside.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@brightside.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 08:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Service impact: regional reachability disruption — customer actions and confirmation

Thanks Markus — thanks for the quick heads-up. A few clarifying questions:

1) If we opt into the override, will existing long-lived streams (SSE/WS) reconnect automatically or require a client-side reconnect?
2) Does the override affect latency SLA for eu users (we have a small subset of EU-facing latency-sensitive endpoints)?
3) Please confirm the exact API call or console clicks — I saw the attachment but want a one-line command we can paste into our runbook.

We can authorize you to perform the opt-in if we receive the customer-opt-in-template.csv signed by our security owner. I looped in ops for visibility.

— Quentin
Quentin Marsh
Sr. Platform Engineer, Brightside Health
quentin@brightside.com

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Quentin Marsh <quentin@brightside.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Service impact: regional reachability disruption — customer actions and confirmation

Quentin — quick answers and the single-line command below. Technical team added to thread for any deeper infra questions.

1) Long-lived streams: existing connections will not be magically re-homed — clients will need to reconnect. Most clients will reconnect automatically depending on their backoff logic. The override keeps new connections routed to the alternate region, so reconnection generally restores service.
2) Latency: traffic will transit a different egress point (us-east-1) which can add 30–120ms for EU origin traffic depending on network path. We will mark endpoint prefixes as temporary and can route only a subset of endpoints if you prefer to limit impact to non-latency-critical calls.
3) One-line API (paste into runbook):
   curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/accounts/BRIGHTSIDE/affinity-override \n     -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>' \n     -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n     -d '{"preferred_region":"us-east-1","duration_hours":24}'

If you want us to perform the opt-in, reply with the completed customer-opt-in-template.csv; once received we will execute from support and confirm within 2–3 minutes.

We will also post a short status update in the incident Slack channel as we apply the fabric patch.

— Markus

From: CloudPortal NOC <noc@cloudportal.io>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 03:12:00 +0000
Subject: Fwd: Incident note — control plane policy propagation repaired in ap-northeast-1

----- Forwarded message from CloudPortal NOC -----
From: CloudPortal NOC <noc@cloudportal.io>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 03:12:00 +0000
To: redwood-support@cloudportal.io
Subject: Incident update — propagation repaired

We have repaired the control-plane propagation issue across the fabric in ap-northeast-1 and eu-west-1. Full propagation completed at 03:05 UTC. We recommend customers keep affinity overrides in place for an additional 4 hours to ensure KV cache priming and stable session behavior.

Affected ranges: 172.20.0.0/18 (edge egress blocks) and a prefix rewrite on 35.77.0.0/16 was temporarily applied.

--- end forwarded message ---

Note for internal ops: CloudPortal confirmed rollback window; coordinate rollback with Markus/Ben once customer reconnections are validated.

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Quentin Marsh <quentin@brightside.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 02 Dec 2026 15:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Service impact: regional reachability disruption — customer actions and confirmation

Quentin — quick wrap and next steps (postmortem follow-up):

Thank you for sending back the signed opt-in (we received your CSV at 09:12 UTC on 2026-11-30). We executed the affinity override on your tenant at 09:16 UTC and monitored reconnections. By 09:28 UTC > 98% of your endpoints had re-established sessions. CloudPortal completed their fabric repair at 03:05 UTC on 2026-12-01 and we started staged rollback for tenants who did not opt-in at 11:45 UTC.

Immediate asks for Brightside:
- Confirm whether you want us to leave the affinity override in place for 24h after we fully rollback (recommended window to let caches re-warm).
- Share any reconnection metrics or client-side errors you saw (attach logs if helpful).

Planned postmortem deliverables from Redwood by 2026-12-04:
- Technical RCA (root cause: third-party peering policy propagation bug + suggested mitigations)
- List of tenants impacted and timeline of actions we took per tenant
- Mitigation plan: persistent health-check failover and automated opt-in runbook for future incidents

If you'd like us to schedule a short 30-min sync tomorrow to walk through the RCA and customer-impacted endpoints, propose a time and we'll send a calendar invite.

— Markus
